verdict.rationale: PostHog documents bulk data movement at scale — batch exports (posthog-docs-44), CDP destinations syncing 50+ tools in bulk (posthog-docs-34), and warehouse syncing whole tables (posthog-docs-9) — plus a query API for running large SQL queries. But there's no documented capability for an AI agent to perform bulk CRUD operations across many discrete items (e.g., batch-update flags, bulk-tag events, bulk-close issues) via MCP or API; the MCP `call` tool and API docs describe single-item operations with explicit pagination/export limits (posthog-supp-query-endpoint notes the query endpoint 'is not a supported export mechanism'). Missing for 10: explicit bulk-item CRUD endpoints/MCP tools, evidence of multi-item batch operations in one call, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale agent workflows.
